skills.name: Element: Fire (火神招来)
skills.description:
Syaoran attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.
''(While Syaoran is in his 1st or 2nd skin, this skill changes to Element: Wind.)''

skills.name: Element: Wind (風華招来)
skills.description:
Syaoran attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.
''(While Syaoran is in his 3rd skin, this skill changes to Element: Fire.)''

skills.name: Magic Trace (魔力追踪)
skills.description:
At the end of turn, Syaoran has a 70% chance to gain an Ofuda. When an Ofuda is consumed, his HP is recovered by 65% of his ATK for per Ofuda.
''(While Syaoran is in his 3rd skin, this skill's icon changes into an ofuda with a cool toned glow.)'' ;Ofuda (道符) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack decreases the onibi cost of his special skill by 1 and decreases his damage received by 15%.

upgrades.text: When ally other than himself uses a special skill on their turn, he gains an Ofuda (max of 1 per turn).
When the current HP for any enemy is less than or equal to their initial max HP, his move bar is increased by 15%.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically starts battle with 1 Ofuda.

skills.name: Element: Lightning (雷帝招来)
skills.description:
Syaoran consumes all Ofuda and for each Ofuda consumed, he decreases an targeted enemy's initial max HP by 11% (each decrease from a consumed Ofuda cannot exceed 235% of his initial ATK), lasts for 5 turns. Then attacks them dealing damage equal to 289% of his ATK.
''(While Syaoran is in his 3rd skin, this skill changes to Element: Ice.)'' ;Ofuda (道符/御札) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Each stack decreases the onibi cost of his special skill by 1 and decreases his damage received by 15%.

upgrades.text: For each Ofuda consumed, the damage multiplier is increased by 40%.
For each 1% of reduced max HP the enemy has, also decreases their non-crit damage dealt by 1%.
